neighbours.label: word-internal piece of a split medical condition term, above all ' ul' in 'ulcers' (also d-andr-uff, bacteri-oph-ages)
fire: Stomach ulcers are often caused by a bacterial infection.
The patient developed painful ulcers on the inside of her cheek.
Pressure ulcers can form when bedridden patients are not moved.
Some cats get ulcers on their tongue from the virus.
Diabetics should check their feet daily for ulcers and cuts.
Medicated shampoo can reduce dandruff within a few weeks.
Leg ulcers heal slowly in people with poor circulation.
His doctor prescribed a cream for the mouth ulcers.
quiet: Stomach aches are often caused by a bacterial infection.
The patient developed painful sores on the inside of her cheek.
Pressure marks can form when bedridden patients are not moved.
Some cats get blisters on their tongue from the virus.
Diabetics should check their feet daily for cuts and bruises.
Medicated shampoo can reduce itching within a few weeks.
Leg wounds heal slowly in people with poor circulation.
His doctor prescribed a cream for the mouth rash.

notes: Card: ' ul' x6 (mouth ulcers), 'andr' (dandruff), 'oph' (bacteriophages); + pole is Stre-pt-ococcus. Probe: 'mouth ulcers' 0.90, dandruff 0.32, 'mouth sores' 0.24.
